ownerReport.title: Owner report
ownerReport.blurb: The report families take home after a dental visit — sections, headings, wording, language, and the practice-wide default layout.

deletion.blurb: Permanently deletes the practice and every chart shared with it, including your team’s, and cancels any subscription. Team members keep their accounts and private charts.
